title: Exterior from northwest
camera_position: from the northwest corner of 18th Street and Prairie Avenue
creator: Cervin Robinson for HABS

rights_basis: Made for HABS (U.S. Government). LOC: no known restrictions on images made by the U.S. Government.
found_via: existing acquisition (data/sources.csv pa-glessner-habs-photo-01); LoC record re-confirmed via loc.gov/pictures search "Glessner house chicago" 2026-10-01
notes: HABS IL-1015 photograph 1 of 17. LOC caption: “1. Historic American Buildings Survey Cervin Robinson, Photographer July 23, 1963 EXTERIOR FROM NORTHWEST - John J. Glessner House, 1800 South Prairie Avenue, Chicago, Cook County, IL”. Cervin Robinson, photographer, for HABS, July 23, 1963. Call number HABS ILL,16-CHIG,17--1. Master TIFF 060903pu.tif (4867×3486 px, 8-bit grayscale) held in Internet Archive item master-pnp-habshaer-il-il0100-il0118-photos; the web copy here is 1800 px. Evidence limit: Shows the house in 1963, after the Glessner family years. Use for surviving exterior fabric, not as the 1904 state. Later evidence: shows the house after the 1940s–50s institutional use (porte-cochère doors replaced by an overhead garage door in the 1950s, per Glessner House Museum); the stone envelope is unchanged from 1904.
